caption: The drawing depicts a single spur, which is an object traditionally worn on the heel of a boot, used in horseback riding. The spur has a brown leather strap adorned with embossed, ornamental patterns. Attached to the strap is an ornate metal piece, predominantly silver in color, with elaborate etched or engraved designs, including a large circular floral or starburst pattern on the side. The metal arm extends backward and ends in a multi-pointed, star-shaped rowel, also in a dark metallic color. A short chain links two points near the fastening buckle. The image is centered on a plain, off-white or light beige background with a slight texture, and there are no other objects in the drawing. There is a small signature or label at the lower right corner reading "W. Kirchoff."
title: Spur
